curated-fs-array-bitter: Futuristic and precise, Array leads with open curves and big lowercase eyes. Bitter, a slab-serif, backs it with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s, so paragraphs stay easy on the eyes and grounded.
curated-fs-array-gf-league-gothic: Sharp, tall and tightly packed, League Gothic runs narrow beneath Array's open curves and large lowercase eyes. Array is best at looking futuristic up top; League Gothic is best at squeezing words in.
curated-fs-array-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display brings a big, tall middle zone to every word, under Array's open-ended curves (a racing game UI could use that). Longer text would feel approachable and unfussy.
curated-fs-bevellier-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab carries a dense middle zone and open throats in a, c, e and s, while Bevellier above it looks stencil-cut and close-fitted. Roboto Slab keeps things structured, and Bevellier adds a graceful, flat-cut flourish beside it.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-commissioner:
Bonny's etched-glass strokes carry a literary, refined feel.

Commissioner sits below with smooth curves that never shift in weight, so the heading's subtle thick-and-thin variation stands out against a body that simply reads.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-dotgothic16: Pixel-soft and quietly bookish, this pairing sets a tube-like body under a pressed-metal heading. DotGothic16 holds one line weight through every bend, which makes Bonny's gently thinned diagonals feel almost handmade, perhaps on a jewelry brand card.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-elms-sans: Bonny has a literary, understated stroke variation, like lines lightly etched. Elms Sans, a sans-serif, runs a plain ballpoint line with a see-through s, so paragraphs would flow smoothly, say on a leatherwork stamp.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-jost: Jost reads with broad gaps at the terminals and pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. And Bonny's soft shifts in thickness make it the warmer partner, which is the real draw, even for a soap and bath products label.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-mohave: Tight-set lines with a literary lean. Mohave answers with tiny slivers of space between glyphs and crossbars as thick as its stems, which gives Bonny's in-between strokes something sturdy to sit against.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-monda: Bonny has the moderate thinning of letters stamped in soft metal, which gives headings a refined, literary tone. Monda keeps small counters unclogged, say for a workshop class sign up.
